message.content:
This document is the README and technical documentation for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine that runs very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware by tiering experts across VRAM, RAM, and NVMe SSD.

**Core concept**
- Runs GLM-5.3-Flash (321B params, ~18B active, 1M context, MIT) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748B, MIT), plus experimental MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428B).
- Experts are placed by heat: hottest
